lectures.title: Correlated Electrons and Quantum Magnetism
lectures.summary: Hubbard model, Hartree–Fock theory for general magnetic order, spin waves in the ladder-sum approximation and the spin stiffness, Coulomb matrix elements, and the strong-coupling expansion to the Heisenberg model, J = 4t2/U.

lectures.title: Quantum Spin Liquids and the Projective Symmetry Group
lectures.summary: Parton mean-field theory, gauge fluctuations, Gutzwiller projection, Schwinger bosons, and the projective symmetry group, with the Z2 PSGs of Schwinger bosons on the triangular lattice worked out in full.

lectures.title: Topology and Gauge Fields
lectures.summary: Landau levels, the Bloch bundle, Berry phase and Chern numbers, two-band Dirac models, bulk–edge correspondence, spontaneous symmetry breaking, the kink, and the abelian and non-abelian Higgs mechanism.

lectures.title: Replica Fluctuations and the Replicon
lectures.summary: Stability of the replica-symmetric solution of the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model: longitudinal, anomalous and replicon sectors, the de Almeida–Thouless line, Parisi replica-symmetry breaking, ultrametricity, and the Nishimori line. With exercises and solutions.
